typeText:

  (hv : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.Valid γ)
  (hv' : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.Valid (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.extendBy γ es ns)),
  Eq.{1}
    (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.testTerms (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.extendBy γ es ns) hv')
    (DisequalityDispersion.mapVarTests (Fin.castLE ⋯) (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.testTerms γ hv))

source.code:
/-- The tests of the extended instance are the old tests, cast. -/
theorem testTerms_extendBy (hv : γ.Valid) (hv' : (γ.extendBy es ns).Valid) :
    (γ.extendBy es ns).testTerms hv' =
      mapVarTests (Fin.castLE (γ.k_le_extendBy es ns)) (γ.testTerms hv) := by
  have hb := (γ.valid_iff.mp hv).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  unfold testTerms mapVarTests
  show (γ.tests.map _) = (γ.tests.map _).map _
  rw [List.map_map]
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro ij hij
  simp only [Function.comp]
  rw [γ.termD_extendBy es ns hv hv' _ (hb ij hij).1, γ.termD_extendBy es ns hv hv' _ (hb ij hij).2]
  rfl
